Druck in New Market Wizards

"At the time, our firm had assets of just under $50,000, and I was absolutely convinced that interest rates were coming down. I took all of the firm's capital and put it into T-bill futures. In four days, I lost everything.

The irony is that less than a week after we went bust, interest rates hit their high for the entire cycle. They've never been that high since. That was when I learned that you could be right on a market and still end up losing if you use excessive leverage."
